SIE.name: Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) Exam
SIE.passing_score_note: FINRA reports a scaled score; 70 is the passing standard on that scale (scores are equated across forms), not literally 70% raw.

sections.title: Understanding Trading, Customer Accounts and Prohibited Activities

notes: Outline PDF is dated 2025-10. The pretest item count was reduced from 10 to 5 (80 total items) per the current outline.
Retake waiting period: 30 days after 1st and 2nd failures, 180 days after 3rd; reduced to 15 and 60 days effective January 19, 2027 (FINRA Regulatory Notice 26-18).

S7.name: Series 7 - General Securities Representative Qualification Examination (GS)
S7.passing_score_note: Scaled passing standard of 72 (equated across forms).

sections.title: Seeks Business for the Broker-Dealer from Customers and Potential Customers
Opens Accounts After Obtaining and Evaluating Customers' Financial Profile and Investment Objectives
Provides Customers with Information About Investments, Makes Recommendations, Transfers Assets and Maintains Appropriate Records
Obtains and Verifies Customers' Purchase and Sales Instructions and Agreements; Processes, Completes and Confirms Transactions

notes: Outline PDF is dated 2025-10. Percentages are rounded by FINRA (7/9/73/11); item counts are exact.
Margin is in outline 4.4 (S7-4); options strategies are in 3.2 (S7-3).
Must be associated with and sponsored by a member firm to sit for the exam.
Retake waiting periods change January 19, 2027, same as the SIE (Regulatory Notice 26-18).
